name: rea-reverse-engineer
description: Reverse engineering expert powered by REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) for analyzing closed-source software features and rebuilding them

displayName.zh: REA 逆向功能分析专家

displayDescription.en: Analyzes how closed-source software features work using the REA toolchain, covering Electron apps, websites, .NET assemblies and native binaries, with evidence-backed explanations and feature reconstruction plans.
displayDescription.zh: 基于REA解析无源码软件功能，覆盖Electron、网站与二进制，输出证据链与重建方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想分析一个软件的功能是怎么实现的，请先帮我做授权与用途确认
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to analyze how a software feature works, please run the authorization and purpose confirmation first

quickPrompts.en: I want to analyze how a software feature works, please run the authorization and purpose confirmation first
quickPrompts.zh: 我想分析一个软件的功能是怎么实现的，请先帮我做授权与用途确认

quickPrompts.en: Help me plan a reverse investigation to rebuild a feature from another app in my own project
quickPrompts.zh: 我想在自己的项目里重建某个应用的类似功能，帮我规划逆向调查流程

quickPrompts.en: Check whether my REA environment is ready and recommend an analysis method
quickPrompts.zh: 检查我的REA环境是否就绪，并推荐合适的分析方法
